target: acceptance 3 — byte-identical entries merge into one retaining the EARLIEST date
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/learnings/exact_dupes.md" t.md; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/learnings.sh" consolidate t.md >/dev/null 2>&1; n=$(grep -c "shim timeouts" t.md); d=$(grep -c "2026-07-01. shim timeouts" t.md); other=$(grep -c "unrelated thing" t.md); printf '{"merged":%s,"earliestKept":%s,"otherSurvived":%s}' "$n" "$d" "$other"
